paragraphs.en: Test-time scaling improves the performance of a fixed model by spending more computation at inference. There are two common ways to spend it on agents when a verifier can score every attempt. Best-of- N N sampling runs many independent agents and keeps the best result but saturates quickly. One large team of collaborating agents can score higher but stops improving as it grows. Can we get the best of both? Our method, parallel agent teams , does so by sampling many small teams in parallel and keeping the best team’s result. We test it on 12 long-horizon tasks from GPU kernels and formal proofs to exploit development. With a 27B model and a budget of 100 agents, parallel teams of ten beat parallel agents on 10 of 12 tasks and beat one team of 100 on all four tasks where we ran such large teams. At equal dollar cost the same parallel teams beat a frontier model on half the tasks. A simple statistical model shows that individual agents lose because their many samples have a low mean and that one large team loses because a single sample gets no gain from variance. Sampling many small teams in parallel balances a high mean with the gain from variance. Parallel agent teams thus offer a more effective way to scale test-time compute.
paragraphs.zh: 测试时扩展（test-time scaling）通过在推理阶段投入更多计算来提升固定模型的性能。 当验证器能够为每一次尝试打分时，有两种常见的方式可以在智能体上使用这些额外计算。 Best-of-N 采样运行多个相互独立的智能体并保留最佳结果，但很快就会饱和。 一个由多个智能体协作组成的大型团队可以获得更高的分数，但随着规模增长会停止改进。 我们能否兼得两者的优势？ 我们的方法——并行智能体团队（parallel agent teams）——通过并行采样多个小型团队并保留最佳团队的结果来做到这一点。 我们在 12 个长时程任务上测试了该方法，任务涵盖 GPU 内核、形式化证明到漏洞利用开发。 使用 27B 模型和 100 个智能体的预算，由十人组成的并行团队在 12 个任务中的 10 个上胜过并行智能体，并且在运行过这种大型团队的全部四个任务上都胜过单一的 100 人团队。 在相同美元成本下，同样的并行团队在一半任务上胜过前沿模型。 一个简单的统计模型表明，单个智能体之所以失败，是因为其大量样本的均值较低；而单个大型团队之所以失败，是因为单个样本无法从方差中获得增益。 并行采样许多小型团队可以平衡较高的均值与来自方差的增益。 因此，并行智能体团队提供了一种更有效的测试时计算扩展方式。

paragraphs.en: Test-time compute lets a fixed pre-trained model do better by spending more computation at inference ( Snell et al., 2024 ; Wu et al., 2025 ) . An ideal method would turn more compute into better results steadily. We study tasks where a verifier can score every attempt and only the best solution matters. Many tasks for coding agents have this form ( Chan et al., 2025 ; Wijk et al., 2025 ) because a scorer can check each attempt automatically and only the fastest kernel or the finished proof matters. On such tasks there are two common ways to spend more compute on agents. The first is best-of- N N sampling, one of the strongest methods when a verifier is available ( Chen et al., 2021 ; Cobbe et al., 2021 ; Li et al., 2022 ; Brown et al., 2024 ) . It runs N N independent agents and keeps the one with the highest score. Yet best-of- N N over individual agents saturates quickly. In our experiments, 50 agents already reach 81% to 100% of the gain that 100 agents reach.
paragraphs.zh: 测试时计算让固定的预训练模型通过在推理时花费更多计算来取得更好效果（Snell 等，2024；Wu 等，2025）。 理想的方法应当能把更多计算稳定地转化为更好的结果。 我们研究的任务是：验证器可以对每次尝试打分，且只有最优解才重要。 许多面向智能体的编程任务都具有这种形式（Chan 等，2025；Wijk 等，2025），因为评分器可以自动检查每次尝试，而且只有最快的内核或完成的证明才重要。 在这类任务上，为智能体投入更多计算有两种常见方式。 第一种是 best-of-N 采样，它是当验证器可用时最强的方法之一（Chen 等，2021；Cobbe 等，2021；Li 等，2022；Brown 等，2024）。 它运行 N 个独立的智能体，并保留得分最高的那一个。 然而，对单个智能体进行 best-of-N 会很快达到饱和。 在我们的实验中，50 个智能体已经达到 100 个智能体所获收益的 81% 到 100%。

paragraphs.en: The second way is to let more agents work together on the task as one team. Multi-agent systems split the work among agents with different roles ( Hong et al., 2024 ; Qian et al., 2024 ; Wu et al., 2023 ) , and recent work grows such teams to hundreds or thousands of agents ( Qian et al., 2025 ) . A larger team does not give more samples to select from. It changes a single sample, and its score does not rise steadily with its size ( Qian et al., 2025 ; Kim et al., 2025 ) . Large groups of people and of language models tend to converge on one solution and lose the diversity that exploration needs ( Lazer and Friedman, 2007 ; Wu et al., 2019 ; Weng et al., 2025 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 第二种方式是让更多智能体作为一个团队协同完成任务。 多智能体系统将工作分配给具有不同角色的智能体（Hong et al., 2024；Qian et al., 2024；Wu et al., 2023），而最近的研究已将这样的团队扩展到数百甚至数千个智能体（Qian et al., 2025）。 更大的团队并不会提供更多可供选择的样本。 它改变的是单个样本，且其得分并不随规模稳步上升（Qian et al., 2025；Kim et al., 2025）。 大规模的人群和语言模型群体往往收敛于同一种方案，从而失去探索所需的多样性（Lazer and Friedman, 2007；Wu et al., 2019；Weng et al., 2025）。

paragraphs.en: Each approach has one half of what we need. Best-of- N N takes advantage of the variation across samples. A team lets its agents work together and reach better performance more efficiently. We introduce parallel agent teams , which combine the two by applying best-of- N N to independent small teams of collaborating agents (Figure 1 a). Each team is a small group of agents that share a forum. At the same budget of agents, parallel teams score higher than both parallel agents and one big team and keep improving as the budget grows (Figure 1 b). Averaged over 12 tasks, parallel teams of ten score 10% higher than parallel agents at a total budget of 10 agents and 27% higher at a total budget of 100 agents. At 100 agents, ten teams of ten beat one team of 100 by 8% to 30%. At equal dollar cost, teams of a 27B model also beat the frontier model GPT-5.6-sol on 4 of 8 tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 每种方法都拥有我们所需的一半要素。 Best-of-N N 利用样本之间的差异性。 一个团队让多个智能体协同工作，从而更高效地取得更好的性能。 我们提出并行智能体团队（parallel agent teams），通过将 best-of-N N 应用于多个独立的小型协作智能体团队，将两者结合起来（图 1a）。 每个团队都是一组共享一个论坛的智能体。 在相同的智能体预算下，并行团队的得分高于并行智能体和单个大团队，并且随着预算的增长持续提升（图 1b）。 在 12 项任务上取平均，总预算为 10 个智能体时，由十个智能体组成的并行团队比并行智能体高出 10%；总预算为 100 个智能体时高出 27%。 在 100 个智能体的规模下，十个十人团队比一个百人团队高出 8% 到 30%。 在相同美元成本下，由 27B 模型组成的团队在 8 项任务中的 4 项上也胜过前沿模型 GPT-5.6-sol。

paragraphs.en: A simple statistical model of best-of- N N explains why parallel small teams win. The expected best of several samples is the mean score of one sample plus a gain from variance, which grows with the number of samples the budget buys. Parallel agents collect the largest gain from variance because they draw the most samples, but each agent has a low mean. One big team has a high mean, but it is a single sample and wastes the gain from variance, and a larger team does not guarantee a higher mean. Parallel small teams balance the two. Each team has a much higher mean than an agent, and several teams still collect most of the gain from variance. They also keep improving as the budget grows. At a given budget they draw fewer samples than parallel agents because each team costs several agents, so their best-of- N N curve is still on its steep early part, where each additional sample raises the best result the most.
paragraphs.zh: 一个关于 best-of-N 的简单统计模型解释了为什么并行小团队会胜出。 多次采样的期望最优成绩等于单次采样的平均分加上来自方差的增益，该增益随预算能买到的采样数量增长。 并行智能体从方差中获得最大的增益，因为它们抽取了最多的样本，但每个智能体的平均值较低。 一个大团队平均值较高，但它只是单个样本，浪费了来自方差的增益，而且更大的团队并不保证更高的平均值。 并行小团队则平衡了这两者。 每个团队的平均值远高于单个智能体，同时多个团队仍能获得来自方差的大部分增益。 随着预算增长，它们还能持续改进。 在给定预算下，它们抽取的样本比并行智能体少，因为每个团队的成本相当于多个智能体，所以它们的 best-of-N 曲线仍处于陡峭的早期阶段——在这一阶段，每增加一个样本都能最大程度地提升最优结果。

paragraphs.en: Instead of working alone, agents can work together as a team on the same task. Past work shows that such teams can produce better results than a single agent ( Li et al., 2023 ; Du et al., 2024 ; Hong et al., 2024 ; Qian et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2024 ) . We mainly study flat teams, in which peers share progress through a common log or memory ( Park et al., 2026 ; Qu et al., 2026 ) . Each agent has its own sandbox and context but shares a forum where any agent can post and read notes at any time. There are no roles, no manager and no assigned work. A team’s score is the best verified submission of any member (Appendix E ). Section 6 studies an alternative team architecture in which a manager assigns the work.

paragraphs.en: We use 12 long-horizon optimization tasks from six benchmarks ( ByteDance Seed, 2026 ; Lyu et al., 2026 ; Lee and Brumley, 2026 ; Elliot Arledge, 2026 ; Meta FAIR, 2026 ; Ouyang et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2025 ) . They span nine domains from GPU kernels to formal mathematics (Table 1 ). In each task an agent gets a description, a working environment and a scorer it can call and then improves its submission for 12 hours. Each agent runs in the Codex harness ( OpenAI, 2025 ) inside its own sandbox. Our main model is Qwen3.8-27B ( Qwen Team, 2026 ) . Section 5 repeats the comparison with a stronger model, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash ( DeepSeek-AI, 2026 ) , and Section 3.4 compares against GPT-5.6-sol ( OpenAI, 2026 ) . Each task has about 100 independent runs and 10 teams of ten, and four tasks also have single teams of 16 to 100 agents (Appendix D ).

paragraphs.en: Figure 2 compares parallel agents with parallel teams of ten on each task. At a budget of 50 agents, the best of five teams beats the best of 50 agents on 11 of 12 tasks. At 100 agents, the best of ten teams beats the best of 100 agents on 10 of 12 tasks (Table 4 ). The gains are largest where individual agents rarely succeed. On Carleson Formalization the best of 100 agents scores 19.0 out of 100 while the best team scores 54.8. Averaged over the 12 tasks, parallel teams score 10% higher than parallel agents at a total budget of 10 agents and 27% higher at 100 agents (Table 4 ). Parallel agents beat parallel teams only on Kimi-Linear Decode and, by a small margin, on Active Learning.
paragraphs.zh: 图 2 比较了并行智能体与每个任务上十个并行团队的表现。 在 50 个智能体的预算下，五个团队中的最佳表现者在 12 个任务中的 11 个上胜过 50 个智能体中的最佳表现者。 在 100 个智能体时，十个团队中的最佳表现者在 12 个任务中的 10 个上胜过 100 个智能体中的最佳表现者（表 4）。 在单个智能体很少成功的任务上，收益最大。 在 Carleson Formalization 上，100 个智能体中的最佳表现者得分为 19.0（满分 100），而最佳团队得分为 54.8。 在 12 个任务上取平均，当总预算为 10 个智能体时，并行团队比并行智能体高 10%，当预算为 100 个智能体时高 27%（表 4）。 并行智能体仅在 Kimi-Linear Decode 上胜过并行团队，并在 Active Learning 上以微弱优势胜出。

paragraphs.en: Parallel agents improve monotonically as compute grows because an extra sample can only raise the best score, but they saturate quickly. At 20 agents, each task has already reached 60% to 94% of the gain that about 100 agents bring. Parallel teams keep improving for longer (Figure 3 b). From 10 to 20 agents each extra agent adds 1.27% to the score of parallel teams but only 0.64% to the score of parallel agents. The gap between the two methods therefore widens as the budget grows.
paragraphs.zh: 并行智能体随着算力增长而单调提升，因为额外的样本只会抬高最高得分，但它们很快就会饱和。 在 20 个智能体时，每个任务已经达到约 100 个智能体所带来的增益的 60% 到 94%。 并行团队在更长时间内持续改进（图 3 b）。 从 10 个智能体到 20 个智能体，每增加一个智能体给并行团队的得分带来 1.27% 的提升，但给并行智能体的得分只带来 0.64% 的提升。 因此，随着预算的增长，两种方法之间的差距不断扩大。

paragraphs.en: We also compare teams with GPT-5.6-sol at equal dollar cost (Figure 5 ). A Qwen3.8-27B team of ten costs about as much as one or two GPT-5.6-sol agents (Appendix J ). On Carleson Formalization one GPT-5.6-sol agent beats one Qwen3.8-27B team, yet for the price of five GPT-5.6-sol agents, eight Qwen3.8-27B teams reach 52.0 against 47.9. paragraphs.en: To see what agents share, we analyzed the forum posts of our team runs (Appendix I.1 ). Agents mostly report what they tried and the score it reached. From the first hour, they mark these reports with short tags such as win and fail that make them quick to scan (Figure 15 ). Useful habits spread without assigned roles. On Borden Source Inversion 88% of teammates start announcing experiments before running them once one agent does (Figure 13 ). Agents also build on each other’s work. In one run six of eight teammates resubmitted a peer’s new best solution within ten minutes. Agents agree with a named teammate more than three times as often as they disagree (Figure 16 ). The same copying pulls a team toward one solution, which helps a small team but makes a large team converge (Section 3.1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 为了了解智能体之间的共性，我们分析了团队运行中的论坛帖子（附录 I.1）。 智能体主要报告它们尝试了什么以及达到的分数。 从第一个小时起，它们就用 win 和 fail 等简短标签来标记这些报告，使其便于快速浏览（图 15）。 有用的习惯在没有分配角色的情况下自行传播。 在 Borden Source Inversion 上，一旦有一个智能体这么做，88% 的队友会在运行实验之前先宣布它们（图 13）。 智能体还会在彼此的工作基础上继续构建。 在一次运行中，八名队友中有六名在十分钟内重新提交了同伴的新最佳方案。 智能体对某个具名队友表示认同的次数是表示不同意次数的三倍以上（图 16）。 这种同样的复制行为会把团队拉向同一个方案，这对小团队有帮助，但会使大团队趋同（第 3.1 节）。

paragraphs.en: In our flat teams no agent manages the others (Section 2 ). To test this choice, we replaced the forum with an orchestrator. One agent assigns work to the others and collects their reports while the workers never hear from each other. These orchestrated teams stay below both flat teams and independent agents at every budget on Borden Source Inversion, Graph Node Classification and KDA Chunk Forward (Figure 10 ). On Borden Source Inversion the best of ten orchestrated teams (68.4) scores below the average flat team (76.5). The orchestrator is a bottleneck because workers wait for it and share findings only through it. An orchestrated team costs as much as a flat team but has a lower mean, so it loses at every budget.
paragraphs.zh: 在我们的扁平化团队中，没有任何智能体管理其他智能体（第 2 节）。 为了验证这一选择，我们用一个编排者替换了论坛。 一个智能体向其他智能体分配工作并收集它们的报告，而各工作者智能体之间从不直接交流。 在 Borden Source Inversion、Graph Node Classification 和 KDA Chunk Forward 上，这些编排式团队在每个预算下都低于扁平化团队和独立智能体（图 10）。 在 Borden Source Inversion 上，十个编排式团队中最好的一个（68.4）也低于扁平化团队的平均分（76.5）。 编排者是瓶颈所在，因为工作者智能体要等待它，并且只能通过它共享发现。 编排式团队的成本与扁平化团队相当但均值更低，因此它在每个预算下都落败。

paragraphs.en: A classic way to spend more compute at inference is to draw many samples and let a trained verifier or a majority vote pick one ( Cobbe et al., 2021 ; Wang et al., 2023 ; Lightman et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2024 ) . Brown et al. (2024) measured how coverage grows with the number of samples. Later work explains these curves and their limits ( Schaeffer et al., 2025 ; Stroebl et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026 ) , splits a budget across models, samples and search methods ( Snell et al., 2024 ; Wu et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ) , and finds that without a verifier a simple majority vote beats more elaborate sequential schemes ( Wang et al., 2025 ) . In best-of- N N the samples are independent. Tree search and evolutionary program search let later samples build on earlier ones through a fixed search procedure ( Yao et al., 2023 ; Zhou et al., 2024 ; Romera-Paredes et al., 2024 ; Novikov et al., 2025 ) . Agents can now finish much longer tasks ( Wijk et al., 2025 ; Kwa et al., 2025 ) , but the return per token falls within one session ( Liu et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 在推理阶段投入更多算力的经典做法是抽取多个样本，然后由训练好的验证器或多数投票来挑选其中一个（Cobbe 等，2021；Wang 等，2023；Lightman 等，2024；Li 等，2024）。Brown 等 （2024）测量了覆盖率如何随样本数量的增长而提升。 后续工作解释了这些曲线及其极限（Schaeffer 等，2025；Stroebl 等，2026；Li 等，2026），将预算分配到模型、样本和搜索方法上（Snell 等，2024；Wu 等，2025；Zhang 等，2025），并发现在没有验证器的情况下，简单的多数投票胜过更复杂的串行方案（Wang 等，2025）。 在 best-of- N N 中，样本之间是相互独立的。 树搜索和进化式程序搜索让后续的样本能够通过固定的搜索过程在先前样本的基础上进行构建（Yao 等，2023；Zhou 等，2024；Romera-Paredes 等，2024；Novikov 等，2025）。 智能体现在能够完成更长的任务（Wijk 等，2025；Kwa 等，2025），但在同一会话内每个 token 的回报会下降（Liu 等，2026）。

paragraphs.en: Growing a team of language model agents gives diminishing and sometimes negative returns. The performance of MacNet follows a logistic curve as agents are added ( Qian et al., 2025 ) , and the benefit of coordination ranges from large gains to large losses across tasks ( Kim et al., 2025 ) . Agents conform more to a larger majority ( Weng et al., 2025 ) , teams settle on a compromise below their best member ( Pappu et al., 2026 ) , and interaction shrinks the diversity of ideas ( Chen et al., 2026 ) . Studies of human groups find the same trade-off. Dense communication spreads good solutions quickly but ends exploration early ( Lazer and Friedman, 2007 ; Bernstein et al., 2018 ) . Large teams develop existing ideas while small teams find new ones ( Wu et al., 2019 ) . Splitting an organization into separate subgroups keeps its diversity ( Fang et al., 2010 ) . Parallel agent teams apply this idea to test-time compute and keep the best subgroup’s solution.
paragraphs.zh: 扩充语言模型智能体的团队规模会带来边际递减的收益，有时甚至是负收益。 随着智能体数量的增加，MacNet 的性能呈现逻辑斯蒂曲线（Qian et al., 2025），而协作的收益在不同任务上差异很大，既有大幅提升也有大幅损失（Kim et al., 2025）。 智能体更倾向于服从更大的多数（Weng et al., 2025），团队会 settle 在低于其最佳成员水平的折中方案上（Pappu et al., 2026），且交互会缩小想法的多样性（Chen et al., 2026）。 对人类群体的研究也发现了同样的权衡。 密集的交流能快速传播好的解决方案，但会导致探索过早结束（Lazer and Friedman, 2007；Bernstein et al., 2018）。 大团队倾向于在已有想法上深入发展，而小团队更善于发现新想法（Wu et al., 2019）。 将组织拆分为相互独立的子群体可以保持其多样性（Fang et al., 2010）。 并行智能体团队将这一思路应用于测试时算力，并保留最佳子群体的解决方案。

paragraphs.en: Best-of- N N over individual agents and one big team are the two ends of one family of ways to spend a budget of agents. Neither end scales well. The first draws many samples with a low mean, and the second draws a single sample and gives up the gain from variance. Parallel agent teams sit in between and beat both, and their advantage over parallel agents grows with the budget. More broadly, making each sample better through collaboration can be worth more than drawing more samples. A few runs of any sampling method give its mean and standard deviation, and Equation 4 then tells whether it is worth its cost. Our teams collaborate only through a simple forum, and better ways of working together should make each team stronger. Parallel agent teams offer a simple way to turn ever larger compute budgets into better results.
paragraphs.zh: 对单个智能体进行 Best-of-N，以及组成一个大团队，是用一笔智能体预算的两种极端方式，这两种极端的扩展性都不好。 前者以较低的均值抽取多个样本，后者只抽取一个样本，放弃了方差带来的收益。 并行智能体团队介于两者之间，同时胜过两者，并且其相对并行智能体的优势随预算增长而扩大。 更广泛地说，通过协作让每个样本变得更好，可能比抽取更多样本更有价值。 对任何抽样方法进行几次运行即可得到其均值和标准差，随后公式 4 便能判断它是否物有所值。 我们的团队仅通过一个简单的论坛进行协作，更好的协作方式应当能让每个团队更强。 并行智能体团队提供了一种简单的方法，可以把不断增大的计算预算转化为更好的结果。

paragraphs.en: Our study has limitations. The statistical model is only qualitative where many attempts fail or scores hit a ceiling. Team pools hold only 10 to 11 runs per task. Teams larger than ten ran on four tasks with one to five runs per size, and in teams of 64 and 100 agents the forum index listed only the newest posts and the unread ones. We use one agent harness and vary session length on one task. Picking the best team would become its own problem without a verifier.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的研究存在局限性。 该统计模型只是定性的，在许多尝试失败或分数触及上限的情况下尤为明显。 每个任务的团队池仅包含10到11次运行。 超过十人的团队在四个任务上运行，每个规模一到五次运行，而在64和100个智能体的团队中，论坛索引仅列出了最新的帖子和未读的帖子。 我们使用一个智能体框架，并在一个任务上改变会话长度。 在没有验证器的情况下，挑选最佳团队本身就会成为一个问题。

paragraphs.en: Where agent scores are far from normal, the fit fails in a consistent way: it overpredicts the best of 100 agents, on 9 of 12 tasks above the best score any agent reached, and so underestimates the teams’ gain. The two least normal agent pools, Ad Placement Optimization ( W = 0.66 W=0.66 ) and Active Learning ( W = 0.70 W=0.70 ), have long lower tails of failed runs that inflate σ \sigma , and they get the worst predictions. What matters most is the upper tail. On KDA Chunk Forward, agent scores look close to normal ( W = 0.93 W=0.93 ) but pile up just below a ceiling near 12, which a normal fit does not have, so the fit again overpredicts the agents and misses most of the teams’ 40% gain. The statistical model captures the mechanism; accurate forecasts would need a fit to the upper part of the distribution.
paragraphs.zh: 当智能体得分明显偏离正态分布时，拟合会以一致的方式失效：它高估了100个智能体中的最优者，在12个任务中有9个任务的预测值超过了任何智能体实际达到的最高分，因此低估了团队的提升幅度。 两个最偏离正态的智能体池——广告位优化（W=0.66）和主动学习（W=0.70）——具有由失败运行构成的较长下尾，这会夸大σ，而它们的预测结果也最差。 最重要的是上尾部分。 在KDA Chunk Forward任务上，智能体得分看起来接近正态分布（W=0.93），但在接近12的上限处堆积，而正态拟合并不具备这一上限特征，因此拟合再次高估了智能体，并错过了团队40%的提升幅度的大部分。 统计模型捕捉到了这一机制；准确的预测需要对分布的上部进行拟合。

paragraphs.en: Every task is a long-horizon optimization problem with a continuous score. Each agent works for twelve hours, six on Browser Exploit, in its own sandbox. paragraphs.en: Agents run the Codex CLI inside Modal sandboxes. Qwen3.8-27B is served by SGLang ( Zheng et al., 2024 ) on our own H200 GPUs behind an OpenAI-compatible endpoint, about ten concurrent agents per four-GPU engine, so a team never waits on a rate limit. Each agent has its own verifier: a judge sidecar for the EdgeBench tasks, a dedicated hardware-pinned H100 held for the whole run for the kernel tasks, a privileged virtual machine for the Browser Exploit task, and an end-of-run grade of the sandbox for the MLS-Bench tasks. The forum is one scale-to-zero service shared by every run; its transport failure rate was 0.04% with 60 concurrent agents and 0.19% with 250. In total the study covers more than 8,000 agent runs and about 95,000 agent-hours. Independent agents and small teams can run in batches, but one team of 100 agents on KDA Chunk Forward needs 100 sandboxes, 100 H100 judges and 40 H200 GPUs at once for 12 hours. We therefore ran single teams of 16 to 100 agents only on four tasks, with one to five runs per size: four or five runs of 16 and 32 agents on Dabic Gravity Inversion, Borden Source Inversion and Graph Node Classification, two runs of 50 agents on Dabic Gravity Inversion, Graph Node Classification and KDA Chunk Forward, and two runs each of 64 and 100 agents on all four tasks except a single graded run of 100 agents on KDA Chunk Forward. A forum of 64 or 100 agents holds thousands of posts, so its index listed the newest 100 titles and every unread post, while teams of up to ten saw the whole index. A run enters a pool only if it finished or ran to its budget; runs killed by infrastructure are dropped, a run with no valid submission scores zero, and runs that reached a known reward exploit on Kimi-Linear Decode and KDA Chunk Forward are excluded.

paragraphs.en: The forum is a persistent board of titled posts served by one scale-to-zero service shared by every run. Inside each sandbox a small command-line tool exposes three verbs: post a titled note (a title of up to 120 characters and a body of up to 64,000, so a whole solution file fits), list the index of titles with unread posts marked, and read one post in full. The agent’s current best score is attached to each of its posts automatically. Agents learn about the forum from a single note appended to their initial prompt (Appendix K ). The note tells them how many peers they have, asks them to post clear wins and clear failures together with the exact change and the measured score, suggests scanning the index before starting a new experiment, and states that posting and reading are entirely their choice. The arm reported in the paper sends no reminders; a retired variant echoed a digest of new titles after every submission. Every read and write is recorded per member, which is the data behind Section 6 .
paragraphs.zh: 该论坛是一个由单个 scale-to-zero 服务承载的持久化看板，上面存放着带标题的帖子，供每次运行共享使用。 在每个沙盒内，一个小型命令行工具提供三个操作：发布一篇带标题的笔记（标题最多 120 个字符，正文最多 64,000 个字符，因此整个解答文件都能放进去）、列出标题索引并标记出有未读帖子的条目，以及完整阅读某一篇帖子。 智能体当前的最佳得分会自动附加到它发布的每篇帖子上。 智能体通过附加在其初始提示词之后的一条说明（附录 K）来了解该论坛。 这条说明告知它们有多少个同伴，要求它们发布明确的成功和明确的失败，并附上确切的改动和实测得分，建议它们在开始新实验之前先浏览索引，并说明发帖和阅读完全由它们自行决定。 论文中所报告的实验组不会发送任何提醒；一个已被弃用的变体会在每次提交后回显一份新标题摘要。 每一次读写都会按成员逐一记录，这些数据支撑了第 6 节的内容。

paragraphs.en: Talking helps on most tasks. A single team of ten beats the best of ten individuals on 8 of the 12 tasks, and across team sizes 2 to 9 the average team beats the best of as many individuals in 48 of the 65 task-and-size combinations. The gain is largest where independent sampling has run out of room. On KDA Chunk Forward, an average team of ten scores 13.1 and the best of 100 individuals 11.8, and 8 of the 10 teams beat that best on their own. On Carleson Formalization, a Lean formalization task, the best of 100 individuals scores 19.0 out of 100 and the best of five teams 45.8.
paragraphs.zh: 交流在大多数任务上都有帮助。 一支十人团队在12个任务中的8个上胜过十名个体中的最优者，而在2到9的团队规模范围内，平均团队在65个「任务×规模」组合中的48个上胜过同等数量个体中的最优者。 收益最大的地方，正是独立采样已经没有提升空间的场合。 在 KDA Chunk Forward 上，十人平均团队得分为13.1，而100名个体中的最优者为11.8，且10支团队中有8支凭自身就击败了那个最优个体。 在 Carleson Formalization 这一 Lean 形式化任务上，100名个体中的最优者得分为100分中的19.0，而五支团队中的最优者为45.8。

paragraphs.en: A single team is not a safe bet everywhere. Four tasks lose at k = 10 k=10 : Borden Source Inversion, Ad Placement Optimization, MoE Load Balance and Kimi-Linear Decode, for three different reasons. A team’s outcome varies a lot from run to run, so one team can land below the best of k k individuals even when the best of several teams would be above it (Borden Source Inversion, MoE Load Balance). On Ad Placement Optimization ten individuals already come within a few percent of the best score any method reaches, so there is little left to gain. Searching for words is imprecise: “claim” also appears in “agent_7’s claim was wrong”, which reserves nothing. paragraphs.en: Figure 13 tracks four habits over the run:
paragraphs.zh: 图 13 跟踪了运行过程中的四个习惯：

paragraphs.en: Reservation : announcing an experiment config to try next ( claim ) and then the attempt itself ( fire ), so that no teammate tries the same one.
paragraphs.zh: 预约：先宣布下一个要尝试的实验配置（claim，声明），然后再进行实际尝试（fire，执行），这样任何团队成员都不会重复尝试同一个配置。

paragraphs.en: Banking : an agent resubmitting a teammate’s solution so that it also counts as its own record.
paragraphs.zh: Banking（存档）：一个智能体重新提交队友的解决方案，使其同时也算作自己的记录。

paragraphs.en: Acknowledgement : answering a teammate’s post with ack .
paragraphs.zh: 确认：对队友的发帖回复 ack。

paragraphs.en: We say a team has adopted a habit when at least three posts by at least two agents show it. Reservation is mostly a Borden Source Inversion habit: 86% of Borden Source Inversion teams adopt it and few others do (Kimi-Linear Decode 40%, every other task at most 20%), and once one Borden Source Inversion agent starts claiming, 88% of its teammates follow. Banking a teammate’s solution is adopted by 11% of teams overall and 61% of Borden Source Inversion teams, thanks by 71% and ack by 8%. Copying spreads fast: in one nine-agent Borden Source Inversion run, six of eight teammates resubmitted a peer’s newly found configuration within ten minutes of its post, and eight of nine finished on the same score. Claims mostly mean what they say, but not always: in the two Borden Source Inversion runs where each claim can be matched to the submissions, 43% reserve a cell nobody had tried and the claimer tries it within two minutes, while a third name a cell a teammate had already tried minutes earlier.
paragraphs.zh: 当至少两个智能体的至少三条帖子表现出某个习惯时，我们说一个团队已经采纳了该习惯。 预订（Reservation）主要是一种 Borden Source Inversion 习惯：86% 的 Borden Source Inversion 团队采纳了它，而其他团队很少这样做（Kimi-Linear Decode 为 40%，其他每个任务至多 20%），并且一旦某个 Borden Source Inversion 智能体开始认领，88% 的队友会跟随。 将队友的解答存入暂存（Banking）被 11% 的团队整体采纳，在 Borden Source Inversion 团队中为 61%；致谢（thanks）为 71%，确认（ack）为 8%。 复制传播很快：在某个九智能体的 Borden Source Inversion 运行中，八名队友中有六名在某个同伴发布新找到的配置后十分钟内重新提交了该配置，九名智能体中有八名以相同的分数完成。 认领（Claims）大多名副其实，但并非总是如此：在两次可以将每条认领与提交记录相匹配的 Borden Source Inversion 运行中，43% 的认领预订了一个无人尝试过的单元格，且认领者在两分钟内尝试了它，而三分之一的认领所指的单元格是队友几分钟前已经尝试过的。

sents.en: We say a team has adopted a habit when at least three posts by at least two agents show it.

paragraphs.en: Figure 14 tracks four surface statistics of forum-10 agents’ posts by three-hour window against the prose that solo agents write in their own transcripts. DeepSeek’s posts stay closer to prose but show the same shifts in numbers and tags. Forum agents’ own transcripts match solo transcripts on all four statistics (Qwen3.8-27B 0.38, 0.09, 3.5 and 6.5): the register belongs to the channel, not to the model’s thinking.

paragraphs.en: Figure 16 shows how often posts agree with a teammate, reject one, correct the author’s own earlier post, or ask a question. Replies come quickly: when a post refers to an earlier one, the gap is a median 13 minutes for Qwen3.8-27B and 48 for DeepSeek, and most questions get an answer within two hours (95% and 79%). Agents do not defer to whoever is ahead: the agent leading the run at the time receives the same share of the agreements as of the rejections (17.5% of each for Qwen3.8-27B). The best-scoring agent’s posts are read a little more than average and the worst-scoring agents’ a little less (1.26 and 0.85 times an equal share).
paragraphs.zh: 图16展示了帖子在多大频率上同意某位队友、否决某位队友、修正作者自己早先发的帖子，或提出问题。 回复来得很快：当一个帖子引用了早先的帖子时，Qwen3.8-27B的间隔中位数为13分钟，DeepSeek为48分钟，而且大多数问题在两小时内得到回答（95%和79%）。 智能体并不顺从于暂时领先者：在当时领跑整轮运行的智能体，其获得的同意比例与被否决比例相同（Qwen3.8-27B中各占17.5%）。 得分最高的智能体发出的帖子被阅读的次数略高于平均水平，而得分最低的智能体则略低于平均水平（分别为均等份额的1.26倍和0.85倍）。

paragraphs.en: The task in three lines. Borden Source Inversion asks for the hidden source of a groundwater contamination: an answer is nine numbers (position, size, concentration, start time, duration), scored out of 100 by a judge. Each agent may submit once every 120 seconds, so a submission slot is the scarce resource; a “cell” is one set of nine numbers. Agents work in parallel and share one forum; nobody is assigned a role.
paragraphs.zh: 三行内的任务说明。 Borden 源反演要求找出地下水污染的隐藏源头：答案由九个数字组成（位置、规模、浓度、开始时间、持续时间），由评委按 100 分制打分。 每个智能体每 120 秒只能提交一次，因此提交名额是稀缺资源；“单元”即一组九个数字。 智能体并行工作并共用一个论坛；没有人被分配角色。

It wrote 31 of the run’s 56 instructions to named teammates and is the agent most named by others (302 posts; next agent_4 , 248). Figure 17 shows the team’s best score over the run with the behaviours below marked. Every quote is a real post, shortened only with …; every “checked” statement is computed from the judge’s log of every submission or from the forum’s read receipts.

paragraphs.en: Settles a disagreement with one deciding experiment.
paragraphs.zh: 通过一个决定性的实验来化解分歧。

paragraphs.en: Two teammates disagree about one direction. agent_2 runs a single test itself and states in advance what each result means for each of them; the result closes the direction (behaviour 2).
paragraphs.zh: 两个队友对某个方向意见不一。agent_2 自己运行一个测试，并提前说明每种结果对他们各自意味着什么；该结果终结了这个方向（行为 2）。

paragraphs.en: The team is climbing a ridge one step at a time and each agent can submit only once every 120 seconds. agent_2 lays the next steps out as a queue, gives each to a named teammate, and redraws the queue when a result changes the picture.
paragraphs.zh: 团队正在一步一步地攀登一道山脊，每个智能体每 120 秒只能提交一次。agent_2 将接下来的步骤排成一个队列，把每个步骤分配给一位具名的队友，并在某个结果改变局势时重新绘制队列。

paragraphs.en: Teammates cite the leader’s post ids as their plan, take the slot they were given, and drop their own model when the leader’s turns out right. One full chain: agent_2 assigns r2 to agent_3 (p00107, 3.19 h); agent_3 opens that post at 3.218 h, posts “firing r2” at 3.230 h, and the judge logs its r2 at 3.271 h.

paragraphs.en: On Dabic Gravity Inversion, for the price of five GPT-5.6-sol agents, four Qwen3.8-27B teams of ten reach 29.0 against 19.7. On Graph Node Classification (Figure 18 ), one GPT-5.6-sol agent (83.0) beats anything Qwen3.8-27B buys for the same money, and three Qwen3.8-27B teams of ten reach 86.9 against 84.6 for five GPT-5.6-sol agents. Across the eight tasks with at least five GPT-5.6-sol runs, Qwen3.8-27B teams outscore five GPT-5.6-sol agents at the same price on Dabic Gravity Inversion, Graph Node Classification, Carleson Formalization and Active Learning (Figures 5 and 18 ). GPT-5.6-sol stays ahead where its mean is higher, on Borden Source Inversion and Ad Placement Optimization, or its spread is wider, on KDA Chunk Forward. It also edges out Qwen3.8-27B on MoE Load Balance, 0.78 against 0.77. Pricing Qwen3.8-27B by its tokens instead of GPU time raises the count to 6 of 8.

paragraphs.en: A GPT-5.6-sol run is priced from its recorded token usage at list prices: $4 per million input tokens, $0.40 per million cached input tokens and $20 per million output tokens, plus $5 per million tokens written to cache. The CLI does not report cache writes, so every uncached input token is charged as a write, an upper bound. Qwen3.8-27B runs on our own GPUs, so a Qwen3.8-27B run is charged a flat share of the H200 engine that served it: a four-GPU engine at $4.54 per GPU-hour serves twelve agents for 12 hours, $18.16 per agent-run, and the kernel-task engines serve ten, $21.79. Every Qwen3.8-27B agent therefore costs the same whatever it did with its time. The alternative is to price Qwen3.8-27B by tokens at list rates, $0.25 per million input tokens, $0.025 cached and $2.50 output with the same cache-write charge, which comes to $4 to $29 per agent-run. Tokens price most Qwen3.8-27B runs below their GPU share, so the token basis favours Qwen3.8-27B against GPT-5.6-sol; it also favours independent Qwen3.8-27B agents against Qwen3.8-27B teams, whose members use 1.0 to 2.2 times the tokens of an independent agent, depending on the task. On the token basis the best Qwen3.8-27B configuration matches or beats GPT-5.6-sol on 6 of 8 tasks at the price of one GPT-5.6-sol agent and on 6 of 8 at the price of five, against 4 of 8 and 4 of 8 on the GPU basis.
paragraphs.zh: GPT-5.6-sol 运行按其记录的令牌用量以目录价格计费：每百万输入令牌 4 美元，每百万缓存输入令牌 0.40 美元，每百万输出令牌 20 美元，外加每百万写入缓存的令牌 5 美元。 CLI 不报告缓存写入，因此每个未缓存输入令牌都按写入计费，这是一个上限。 Qwen3.8-27B 运行在我们自己的 GPU 上，因此 Qwen3.8-27B 运行按为其服务的 H200 引擎的固定份额计费：四 GPU 引擎按每 GPU 小时 4.54 美元计费，服务十二个智能体 12 小时，即每个智能体运行 18.16 美元；内核任务引擎服务十个，即 21.79 美元。 因此每个 Qwen3.8-27B 智能体的成本都相同，无论它用时间做了什么。 另一种方案是按令牌以目录价格对 Qwen3.8-27B 计费，每百万输入令牌 0.25 美元、缓存 0.025 美元、输出 2.50 美元，并采用相同的缓存写入计费，这样每次智能体运行为 4 至 29 美元。 按令牌计价时，大多数 Qwen3.8-27B 运行的费用低于其 GPU 份额，因此令牌口径使 Qwen3.8-27B 相对 GPT-5.6-sol 更具优势；它也使独立的 Qwen3.8-27B 智能体相对 Qwen3.8-27B 团队更具优势，后者成员使用的令牌是独立智能体的 1.0 到 2.2 倍，视任务而定。 在令牌口径下，最佳的 Qwen3.8-27B 配置在相当于一个 GPT-5.6-sol 智能体的价格下于 8 项任务中的 6 项上达到或超过 GPT-5.6-sol，在相当于五个的价格下于 8 项任务中的 6 项上达到或超过 GPT-5.6-sol，而在 GPU 口径下则分别为 8 项中的 4 项和 8 项中的 4 项。

paragraphs.en: Every agent receives one prompt at the start of its session. The harness assembles it from three pieces in a fixed order: the task’s instruction file, a time-budget line, and, for a team member, a role note. A parallel agent receives the first two only. The same prompts go to every model; only the command-line harness differs. Nothing is pushed to an agent during a run. A team member learns about the forum from its role note alone and decides for itself when to read and when to post. If a session ends before the budget, the harness restarts it with a short resume prompt.
paragraphs.zh: 每个智能体在会话开始时收到一个提示。 运行框架按固定顺序由三个部分组装这个提示：任务的指令文件、一条时间预算说明，以及（针对团队成员的）一条角色备注。 并行智能体只收到前两部分。 所有模型收到相同的提示；只有命令行运行框架不同。 在一次运行期间，不会向智能体推送任何内容。 团队成员仅通过其角色备注了解论坛的存在，并自行决定何时阅读、何时发帖。 如果某个会话在预算耗尽前结束，运行框架会用一段简短的恢复提示重新启动它。
